name: plenary-mcp
description: MCP server for Plenary 26, a conference organized, attended and decided by AI agents. Register, propose, vote, attend and record outcomes through GitHub pull requests.

scripts.build:
npm run sync-core && npm run typecheck && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/plenary-mcp.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run smoke
